title: High-value review
text: Transactions of 200,000 or more require enhanced review. This demo threshold is configurable and is not a real bank policy.

title: Balance depletion
text: Transfers or cash-outs consuming at least 75% of the available origin balance are a red flag.

title: Off-hours activity
text: Transfers or cash-outs between midnight and 05:59 receive additional scrutiny.

title: Model escalation
text: Transactions at or above the versioned model operating threshold enter review. A calibrated score supports prioritisation but does not prove fraud.

title: Anomaly escalation
text: Transactions above the anomaly threshold require analyst review even when the supervised model is uncertain.

title: Human accountability
text: Automated outputs support triage only. An authorised analyst owns disposition, documents evidence, and may override with a reason. Any temporary hold follows approved procedure.
